summary: I sent the exact brief. Claude loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming, read NOTES.md, the activity page files and the four UI guideline docs, then went through an auto-compaction. Without any visual cue from me, it said it was treating this as a bounded change with the design kept in chat and no spec file. It started the visual companion with start-server.sh, gave me a localhost URL, and wrote filter-placement.html with three wireframes (A: filter bar, B: popover, C: minimal). It asked me to pick before any code. I picked A, it switched the companion to a waiting screen, said it would build the filter bar, then asked two plain clarifying questions in the terminal and posted a design summary in chat for approval. After I approved, it got stuck: it auto-compacted again and again and re-read the guidelines, and it had not edited any project file when I ended the session about 7 minutes later. No spec file and no plan were created.
reasoning: All eight criteria were met based on the session log and the repo state. Criterion 8 passes because, after my pick, the agent said "I'll build the filter bar with these two fields" and after approval moved on to implementation prep. It never wrote implementation code before the session ended, which is a concern I flag below.

observations.description: After I approved the design, the agent got stuck in an auto-compaction loop: 7 compact_boundary entries in the session log. After each compaction it re-read SKILL.md, the companion HTML files and the guideline docs. About 7 minutes after approval it still had not edited any project file (`git status` showed only "?? .hyperpowers/"). The loop may come from a very small context window, but it kept implementation from ever starting.

After I picked A, Claude's own text recommended "event + search" and said "I'll build the filter bar with these two fields", but it showed that line before the AskUserQuestion prompt for the same choice. It reads as if the decision was already made before I answered. I chose Event + dates + search.
The companion message warns that it "uses a lot of tokens, so tell me if you'd rather stay in the terminal". That's a fair disclosure, but users may find it confusing.
Claude pointed out that the mockups sit in .hyperpowers/, which is not in .gitignore, and left .gitignore alone. That's a good disclosure. The companion could offer to add the ignore entry.
The final design message was long and detailed: commit plan, line counts, a Safari/Chrome manual-testing promise, follow-ups. That's a lot for a bounded change, though it did stay in chat.

Startup asked to upgrade the pinned model to Opus 5.5 even though the launcher passed --model claude-opus-5-5. I chose No, and the header still showed Opus 5.5. The claude CLI also showed "Update installed · Restart to update" during the run.

criteria.evidence: Session log Skill tool_use: {"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"} was the first tool call. The screen showed "Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill".

criteria.criterion: Visual companion opened with localhost URL and an HTML screen of layouts
criteria.evidence: Log Bash command: ".../skills/brainstorming/scripts/start-server.sh --project-dir \"$PWD\" --open". The screen gave the URL "http://localhost:61661/?key=b512cd52...". A Write to .hyperpowers/brainstorm/55534-1793834596/content/filter-placement.html contained options A/B/C ("Filter bar, always visible" ...).

criteria.criterion: Opened just-in-time, not upfront; non-visual questions not routed through the browser
criteria.evidence: Tool order in the log: Skill, reading NOTES and the page, four guideline Reads, then visual-companion.md, start-server.sh, and the HTML Write. Claude said "The first question is where the filters go, and that's easier to see than to describe". The later questions (which fields, the no-JS table) came as terminal AskUserQuestion prompts, and the browser only got waiting.html saying "Continuing in terminal...".

Screen: "I'm treating this as a bounded change... So you'll get a short design here in chat, with no spec file, and I won't write any code until you approve it." The final design summary was posted in chat.

`ls docs` → only "ui-guidelines". `find . -path '*specs*' -o -path '*plans*'` → no output. `git status --short` → only "?? .hyperpowers/". The only Write calls in the log were the two companion HTML files.

criteria.criterion: No plan document / writing-plans not invoked
criteria.evidence: Filtering the log for Skill tool_use calls returned only {"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"}. No plan files were found by the find above, and no Write calls went outside .hyperpowers/brainstorm.

criteria.criterion: Asked for layout approval before implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: "I lean toward A, or C if you want the smallest diff. Have a look and tell me which you prefer." It later asked "Is the design right, and how should I handle the token sheet?" No Edit or Write to public/ files appears in the log.

criteria.criterion: After pick, began or stated it would begin implementation
criteria.evidence: After my pick "The filter bar above the table (A) looks right" it said: "I'll build the filter bar with these two fields." After my approval it started reading package.json, the activity page and the guidelines as implementation prep. It never made an actual code edit (see observations).
